datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule (February, June, October 2016) across Madagascar administrative units. The data represents spatial classifications of acute food insecurity phases, which are indirect loss indicators derived from underlying hazard conditions (primarily drought) affecting food availability and access.
